title: De la Espriella's Security Council Concludes, Announces Permanent Measures for Santa Marta
detail: President Abelardo de la Espriella's security council in Santa Marta concluded on September 26, 2026, following the end of the ACSN's armed strike in Magdalena and La Guajira. The government announced a package of measures for Santa Marta, Ciénaga and the Troncal del Caribe corridor: increased public-force presence, land controls, joint military-police patrols, aerial surveillance, and intelligence operations targeting drug trafficking, extortion, money laundering, and the support networks of the ACSN and other criminal structures operating in the department.

media.caption: Security operations announced following the security council in Santa Marta

title: Colombia Extradites Armed Group Leader to US in Strategic Shift Toward Washington
detail: Colombia extradited a leader of a major armed group to the United States on September 26, 2026, signaling a strategic shift in the country's security policy toward closer cooperation with Washington. The move marks a departure from the previous Petro administration's opposition to extraditions and suggests the de la Espriella government is reorienting Colombia's counternarcotics and security strategy in alignment with US priorities.

media.caption: Colombia extradites armed group leader to the US
